summary: Add checked, recoverable CPU mining operations to the release node kit
details: Add mining check, enable, disable and status with pinned candidate identity, explicit first-node acknowledgement and one CPU worker by default.
Persist chain-only role transitions under the systemd controller, preserve upstream processes and data, and distinguish runtime drift, warmup, work and canonical local seals.
Explicitly configure discovery in the chain runtime and reject managed mining or consensus flag overrides. Package the new host module with every node kit.
operator_actions: Initialize nodes as full or bootnode, then use usdb-node mining enable --address ADDRESS; add --first-node only for an explicitly acknowledged genesis cold start without seeds.
Use mining disable for persistent shutdown and mining status --watch to observe submitted operations. Replace the chain image to adopt discovery and JSON logging changes.
